caption: The drawing depicts a built-in wooden cabinet positioned flush against a wall. The cabinet is composed of two main sections: an upper section with four vertical, rectangular panel doors and a lower section consisting of two rows of drawers. Each panel door in the upper section has a wooden knob or handle, and the vertical panels are outlined by wooden molds. The lower section features a total of eight drawers, arranged in two horizontal rows of four drawers each. Each drawer is fitted with a round wooden pull knob, and keyholes are present on all drawers. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain patterns, giving a sense of texture. The cabinet has an elaborate, wide crown molding at the top, which projects outward more than the rest of the structure, and the perspective suggests the cabinet is set within a slightly alcoved or recessed area of the wall. The surrounding wall and floor are depicted in light neutral tones, with the wall colored primarily in off-white and pale blue shadows, while the floor is a pale, tan shade with hints of wood grain lines. A signature, "Henri H Hansen," is present in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Built-in Cabinet
